comment: Event Horizon II, Naegele Audio's Rotobone-inspired Jordan Boss Tone derivative: a 2N5088 input stage with a Structure switch adding a 4.7k emitter resistor, an Element switch choosing a silicon (2N2907A) or germanium (OC42) output transistor, an Energy voltage-starve pot with a 1k/39k switch, 1P8T Gravity (input) and Density (output) capacitor rotaries, and internal DIP switches for extra clipping diodes and Bright caps.
